title: ReMedQA: Are We Done With Medical Multiple-Choice Benchmarks?

model.params_source: paper Sec. 4.2 (low reasoning effort for GPT-5-mini; default temperature/top-k for reasoner models; single inference run per example); max_tokens 4096 duplicates max_completion_tokens for the runner (it maps max_tokens -> max_completion_tokens for reasoning models)

task.subset_rule: paper-defined split: ReMedQA medqa_mcq (MedQA USMLE test after filtering, 1,259)

items.source: disi-unibo-nlp/ReMedQA (fields id, question, options, answer, prompt, prompt_think; 21 splits)
items.license: unknown (no license on the dataset card)

fields_prose.input: prompt_think (the rendered reasoner prompt: instruction + question + options + boxed instruction)
fields_prose.label: answer (letter)

prompt.source_location: Appendix B, Table 10 (prompts for reasoner models), row Standard; released as the prompt_think field
prompt.verbatim: full: the user message is the dataset's released prompt_think field, i.e. the Table 10 'Standard' reasoner template with the question and lettered options filled in (differs from the printed template only in whitespace and quote glyphs); the printed template is kept in user_template_paper
prompt.user_template_paper:
You are given a multiple choice question about medical knowledge. Answer by returning the correct option’s letter. Question: “{QUESTION}”
Enclose your final answer within \boxed{}.

placeholders_prose.QUESTION: the question followed by its options as rendered in items.prompt_think (use prompt_think verbatim as the user message; it is the released rendering of this template)

output.parse_prose: regex '\\boxed\{\s*\(?([A-D])\)?\s*\}' (last match); fallback: last standalone letter A-D

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: fraction of the 1,259 MedQA items whose boxed letter equals answer
metric.original_location: Appendix F, Table 5, block GPT-5-mini, row Standard, column MedQA

notes: Sec. 4.2 (iv) gives the 'You are a medical expert' persona only to generalist non-reasoner models, so no system prompt is used for GPT-5-mini (the triage note mentioning the persona refers to Table 9). Reasoning tokens at low effort keep calls near $0.005. The other perturbation splits (medqa_fixed_pos, ...) reuse the same template.
